rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the Rajya Sabha's written answers of 8 January 1991, answering the question of Shri S. S. Ahluwalia (printed 'AHLUWAUA') on the 'Rath Yatra' conducted in October 1990 by the President of a national political party, the Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs, Shri Subodh Kant Sahay, states that 'Shri L. K. Advani, President BJP' conducted the Rath Yatra starting from Somnath on 25 September 1990 and that it was stopped on his arrest at Samastipur, Bihar, on 23 October 1990.

locator.item: Unstarred Question 1586 'Rath Yatra', answer to parts (a) and (b)
